baseline_models.focus_anchor: أحصنت فرجها فنفخنا فيه من روحنا
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus joins enclosure, an opening, directed breath, and life. Guarding therefore regulates a vulnerable threshold: it excludes violation without making the threshold incapable of authorized reception.

activation_trace.role: An enclosing fort supplies active preservation and makes guarding the boundary's governing function.
An opening between two sides supplies the real aperture that preservation must regulate.
A feared open frontier turns the aperture into a watched threshold rather than a sealed wall.
Directed wind entering something supplies authorized passage across the guarded threshold.
Life-bearing spirit supplies the constructive content admitted through that threshold.

changed_reading.before: Mary's chastity is a static condition of sexual closure.
changed_reading.after: Her chastity is selective boundary competence: she preserves an opening precisely enough for violation to be excluded and divinely given life to be received.

baseline_models.mechanism: Verification links intelligible communication to realized deed, while writing joins signs into an enduring and binding record. The clause portrays truth as communication received, enacted, and durably held, not merely an opinion assented to.

activation_trace.role: Making promise or report true in action turns verification into performed fidelity.
Intelligible speech connecting speakers supplies the received communicative event.
Joining one element to another supplies the assembly of separate communications into a coherent record.
An inscription that establishes judgment gives the record durable normative force.
Nurturing, repairing, and completing makes the Lord's communications formative rather than merely informative.

changed_reading.before: She intellectually believed a set of words and books.
changed_reading.after: She made communicated truth effective in conduct and carried its separate utterances as a coherent, binding archive.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مريم ابنت عمران ... وكانت من القانتين
baseline_models.mechanism: The opening names inherited descent, but the close places Mary in a collective through realized, obedient conduct. The sequence moves identity from origin to formed membership without erasing either.

activation_trace.role: Daughterhood supplies the genealogical identity from which the ayah begins.
Construction by joining parts activates a form-distant sense of identity being built across the ayah's acts.
Realized presence in time marks membership as an achieved and sustained state.
Humble religious obedience names the collective practice into which she is placed.

changed_reading.before: The ayah appends a piety label to a woman identified by lineage.
changed_reading.after: It carries a named daughter from inherited origin through her own acts into an enacted collective identity among the devout.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening distinction between imposed prohibition, divine lawfulness, and release from an oath sharpens the focus boundary model. Mary's guarding is calibrated protection under divine authorization, not indiscriminate taboo; the guarded opening can therefore receive the commanded breath without contradiction.

activation_trace.role: Fortified preservation supplies the focus act that context recalibrates.
A genuine opening prevents protection from collapsing into total closure.
Authorized breath demonstrates that guardedness can admit a rightful ingress.
Forbidding supplies the rejected move of converting what is permitted into a blanket boundary.
The lifting of prohibition supplies the counter-pole that keeps a boundary norm-responsive.
Release from an oath shows that even a verbal bond can be lawfully opened rather than absolutized.

structural_cues: 66:1 asks why the lawful was forbidden, and 66:2 immediately supplies release before 66:12 joins guarding to admitted breath.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prohibition, lawfulness, release, and a guarded opening that receives breath; I transfer that normative calibration to the bodily boundary. A live alternative is that 66:1-2 regulate only their oath episode and do not qualify Mary's guarding.

changed_reading.before: Guarding means making the body categorically inaccessible.
changed_reading.after: Guarding means administering access under the right authority: prohibition of violation and openness to divinely authorized life coexist.

context_deltas.mechanism: The secret-relay-exposure sequence makes information itself a vulnerable boundary. Read beside it, Mary's guarding and her verification of words and books become one custodial ethic: neither leaking what is entrusted nor suppressing what must be truthfully received and realized.

activation_trace.role: Enclosing preservation anchors bodily custody in the focus.
Realizing a report in action anchors faithful handling of communication.
Speech connecting speakers identifies what is faithfully received rather than leaked.
Binding inscription gives received communication durable custody.
Concealment in the interior supplies the entrusted secret whose boundary is tested.
News arriving and being relayed supplies repeated crossings of the information boundary.
Exposure supplies the reversal from hidden communication to disclosed fact.
Turning aside from part of the disclosure models selective non-rendering rather than exhaustive exposure.

structural_cues: 66:3 repeatedly tracks a message through pronouns and partial disclosure; 66:12 coordinates guarding with verification of both words and writings.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden speech, relay, exposure, partial turning aside, bodily guarding, and verified texts; I infer a shared logic of entrusted thresholds. A live alternative is that bodily chastity and information fidelity remain separate virtues merely juxtaposed by the surah.

changed_reading.before: Guarding the body and believing revelation are two unrelated merits.
changed_reading.after: They are two surfaces of disciplined custody: she regulates bodily access and handles communication without betrayal, denial, or indiscriminate exposure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The feminine qānitāt list and the protect-command-act sequence fill out the focus's final qānitīn. Devotion is active protective execution: receiving obligation, refusing disobedience, and doing what preserves self and household.

activation_trace.role: Humble religious obedience anchors Mary's final collective classification.
The explicitly feminine devout group anticipates and genders the quality later gathered into qānitīn.
Repelling harm by protection gives obedience a concrete safeguarding task.
Departure from obedience supplies the negative action the angels refuse.
Binding request supplies the directive to which devotion responds.
Producing an act supplies the positive execution that completes non-disobedience.

structural_cues: 66:5 uses feminine qānitāt, 66:6 pairs non-disobedience with actual performance, and 66:12 closes with the broader collective qānitīn.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated q-n-t plus a protection, command, and action grammar; I treat 66:6's angelic pattern as sharpening the function of Mary's devotion. A live alternative is that the angelic description is only analogous and does not define q-n-t.

changed_reading.before: Being among the devout means passive, private submissiveness.
changed_reading.after: It means practiced agency under command: guarding, receiving, verifying, and protecting are the actions by which Mary belongs to the devout collective.

context_deltas.mechanism: The negative exemplum makes intimate relation fail as moral credit: two wives' deficient fidelity cannot be compensated by righteous husbands. Mary's daughterhood is therefore a frame, not her proof; her own guarding, verification, and devotion supply the tested fidelity that relation alone cannot.

activation_trace.role: Daughterhood supplies the inherited relation whose moral sufficiency context questions.
Realized fidelity supplies Mary's own positive answer to the relational test.
Practiced devotion places her by conduct rather than kinship.
Rendering an example signals that the two women are an explicit comparative test case.
An example as admonitory sign directs the comparison toward moral diagnosis.
The two women supply intimate relational positions without guaranteeing fidelity.
Deficiency in trust and fulfillment names the failure opposite Mary's realized verification.
Failed sufficiency shows that righteous proximity cannot substitute for one's own fidelity.

structural_cues: 66:10-12 place two negative women and two positive women in sequence, repeatedly naming relations but judging speech and action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit negative example of failed intimate fidelity followed by Mary's lineage and verbs; I infer that relation is being tested by enacted trustworthiness. A live alternative is that daughterhood is simply honorific biography with no deliberate contrast to the wives.

changed_reading.before: Daughter of Imran primarily marks inherited sanctity or prestige.
changed_reading.after: Lineage identifies where Mary stands, but her own verified fidelity decides what that relation becomes; moral standing is non-transferable and enacted.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prayer to build a near house immediately activates the building branches inside bint. Form-distantly, Mary can be carried as a living built structure: joined and fortified, possessing a watched opening, and made a site of divine life rather than being secured by a marital household.

activation_trace.role: Composite built form lets daughterhood resonate, cautiously, as Mary's own formed structure.
Fortified enclosure gives the living structure protected integrity.
A watched frontier gives that structure a guarded opening rather than featureless walls.
Life-bearing spirit makes the proposed structure living rather than architectural.
Building by joining parts is the explicit action that activates the adjacent construction branch in bint.
Near presence relocates security toward divine proximity rather than social household power.
Dwelling and shelter supply the architectural image transferred to Mary's protected embodiment.
Rescue by separation explains why the desired house is an alternative to a corrupt relational enclosure.

structural_cues: 66:11 ends with a woman asking that a house be built, and 66:12 immediately begins with bint from the same packet root b-n-y.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit building, dwelling, nearness, rescue, and then bint plus fortified aperture; I let the adjacent shared root activate a living-house model. The live alternative, and the main caution, is that bint here carries only lineage and the construction branch is etymologically remote.

changed_reading.before: The house prayer ends with 66:11, while daughterhood in 66:12 is only genealogy.
changed_reading.after: The requested near house echoes into Mary as an exploratory living structure whose guarded integrity and received spirit embody shelter near God outside coercive household power.

context_deltas.mechanism: Context gives breath moving out from an interior and light moving purposefully ahead toward completion. This reopens the focus's breath-spirit pair as a directional cycle: divine life moves inward through the guarded threshold, while luminous witness moves outward and forward.

activation_trace.role: Wind sent into something supplies the inward vector of the focus event.
Air and breeze keep the gift materially legible as movement rather than abstraction alone.
Breath leaving the interior supplies the reverse vector needed for an inward-outward cycle.
Light and illumination supply the outwardly manifest form of received life.
Purposeful motion toward a goal gives the light an active forward trajectory.
Arrival at completeness supplies the trajectory's prayed-for culmination.

structural_cues: 66:8 repeats their light and our light, assigns it motion before them, and asks that it be completed before the focus's inward breath-spirit sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inward breath, outward breath, moving light, and completion; I infer a circulation from received life to public witness. A live alternative is that spirit and eschatological light are distinct gifts with no directional continuity.

changed_reading.before: The breath-spirit is a single inward event confined to Mary's body.
changed_reading.after: It can also initiate a circulation: guarded reception of life becomes purposive radiance moving outward toward completion.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sincere return activates sewing a tear, covering an offense, and protecting its bearer from its effect. Those images meet farj as fissure and ihsan as enclosure, changing Mary's integrity from an unreachable untouched state into a boundary logic that also illuminates repair and restored protection.

activation_trace.role: A fissure or opening supplies the boundary form capable of either protection or repair.
Enclosing preservation supplies the restored function toward which repair tends.
Stitching and closing a tear gives sincere return a concrete repair operation.
Erasing an offense by covering it supplies removal of the breach's moral effect.
Covering the offense while protecting its bearer supplies durable restoration rather than cosmetic concealment.

structural_cues: 66:8 stacks sincere return, covering of wrongs, and forgiveness before the positive women of 66:11-12.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a stitched tear, moral covering, protective forgiveness, and the focus's preserved opening; I transfer the repair sequence to the boundary model. A live alternative is that Mary's intact guarding functions only as exemplar and should not be read through the audience's repentance process.

changed_reading.before: Mary's guardedness is a pristine condition that can only be admired from outside.
changed_reading.after: Her guarded boundary also clarifies restoration: a breach can be stitched, its damage covered, and its protective function re-established without pretending no opening exists.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates kalimah through the bodily wound branch, not the ordinary speech branch. It remains anchored in the focus's words, verification, and writings, but downstream prose should present it as a material analogy for how communication leaves durable embodied marks, never as a claim that the Lord's words injure Mary.

activation_trace.role: A wound as a bodily trace makes a word capable of being imagined as communication that leaves a mark.
Realization in action turns the mark from passive impact into faithfully embodied truth.
Ordered writing gives bodily marking an archival counterpart in arranged signs.
Binding inscription gives the mark enduring consequence.

changed_reading.before: Words and books remain external propositions that Mary accepts.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, words leave truth-bearing marks that her action verifies and her relation to writing preserves as an embodied archive.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is branch-distant and uses the packet's non-dominant r-b-b mapping, so it is easy to suppress. It remains anchored in daughter, breath, Lord, and becoming, but should be rendered only as a material sequence of formation, not as physiology or a lexical replacement for the surface meanings.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ابنت عمران ... فنفخنا فيه من روحنا ... ربها ... وكانت

activation_trace.role: Food building flesh supplies an embodied formation image inside the daughter root inventory.
Filling and expansion by air supplies the first material change in the sequence.
Nourishment and growth from the non-dominant mapped root supplies sustained development rather than a single instant.
Coming to presence in time gives filling and growth a realized endpoint.

changed_reading.before: The ayah reports an instantaneous marvel followed by unrelated belief and devotion.
changed_reading.after: A latent material chain appears: formation, filling, nourishment, and becoming make the whole ayah pulse with staged emergence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The contrast is surprising because it compares two different material-entry scenes rather than asserting an explicit opposition. It remains anchored in the focus's opening, breath, and life and in 66:6's human-and-stone fuel, but downstream prose must call it an ecological or material analogy, not identify Mary with the fire scene.

activation_trace.role: The opening supplies a point at which material relation to an interior is decided.
Sent breath supplies an entering medium that animates rather than burns.
Life-bearing spirit supplies the outcome opposite consumption.
Combustible material supplies the context's destructive model of what can feed an interior process.
Human embodiment identifies one material consumed in the fire scene.
Hard stone intensifies the fire scene's inert combustible materiality.

changed_reading.before: Mary's body is a neutral vessel in an isolated miracle report.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the surah contrasts interiors by what feeds them: destructive fuel makes bodies consumable, while admitted spirit makes a guarded body living and truth-bearing.

strongest_changes: Guarding became calibrated permeability rather than blanket closure.
Bodily integrity and faithful handling of communication became one custodial mechanism.
Qunut became protective execution and enacted collective membership rather than passive piety.
Lineage and household proximity yielded to each woman's own fidelity.
Repentance imagery made the protected-boundary model repairable rather than inaccessible.
summary.what_was_special: The focus repeatedly coupled apparent opposites: fort and opening, concealment and truthful disclosure, inherited relation and earned membership, inward breath and outward light. The adjacent house-building root, the split growth mapping of r-b-b, and the word-as-wound branch preserved the strangest live readings without forcing them into the strong models.
remaining_uncertainties: The living-house reading depends on letting the building branch resonate inside bint across the 66:11-12 boundary.
The breath-to-light cycle is directional inference; the packet does not equate spirit and eschatological light.
The repairable-boundary reading transfers the audience's repentance imagery to Mary's intact guarding.
The growth and word-wound outliers are material analogies, not lexical substitutions or physiological claims.
